scenicChapters.title: Bad Oldesloe fuel gate → Plön lake road
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 61 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

places-hautecombe-baie-de-clendy.story: From Aix-les-Bains it runs 381 km to Aix-les-Bains; allow about 6 h 34 of riding. On the way it passes Secteur des Mongets, Immeuble Clarté, Stations de Morges and Baie de Clendy. It crosses from France into Switzerland - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The line favours views over speed.
